professionalSummary.text: Planned and executed multi-property system replacements across 12 hotels in three waves, with vendor coordination, data migration, and cut-over to live operation.
professionalSummary.witness: planned the replacement of the property management system across 12 hotels in three waves, with a schedule and a dependency log shared with the vendor, plus a readiness checklist for each wave.

professionalSummary.text: Organized staff training in a training copy of the new system with practice bookings, timed around shift patterns.
professionalSummary.witness: Organised front-desk and reservations training in a training copy of the new system, preloaded with practice bookings for each hotel, with sessions timed around shift patterns.

professionalSummary.text: Managed hardware and training budget lines, reporting spend to the IT director monthly.
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the hardware and training lines of the project budget; the IT director held the overall budget. Reported spend on those two lines to the IT director each month.

experienceHighlights.text: Led the replacement of property management systems across 12 hotels in three waves, coordinating with vendors and managing data migration.
experienceHighlights.witness: planned the replacement of the property management system across 12 hotels in three waves, with a schedule and a dependency log shared with the vendor, plus a readiness checklist for each wave.

experienceHighlights.text: Executed cut-overs to live operation for all 12 hotels, with signed go-live approval and two-week stabilisation periods.
experienceHighlights.witness: Cut each wave over to the new property management system overnight, the last of the 12 hotels going live on 29 January 2024, and ran a two-week stabilisation desk after each wave.

experienceHighlights.text: Organized training sessions for front-desk and reservations staff using a training copy of the system with practice bookings.
experienceHighlights.witness: Organised front-desk and reservations training in a training copy of the new system, preloaded with practice bookings for each hotel, with sessions timed around shift patterns.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Wave-three cut-over plan included overnight timeline, reconciliation checklist, fallback decision point at 04:00, and go/no-go criteria for vendor and duty managers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the wave-three cut-over plan, with the overnight timeline, the reconciliation checklist, a fallback decision point at 04:00 and the contact list for the vendor and the hotels' duty managers, plus the go or no-go criteria for the fallback point.

skills.text: Vendor coordination, data migration, staff training, budget management, and cut-over execution.
skills.witness: planned the replacement of the property management system across 12 hotels in three waves, with a schedule and a dependency log shared with the vendor, plus a readiness checklist for each wave.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's role in planning, data migration, cut-over execution, training, and budget management for a 12-property system replacement. They do not establish the candidate's direct approval of go-live (only that the candidate was named on the certificate), nor the candidate's management of the overall project budget (only the hardware and training lines).
